macos_arm64.notes: Bundled universal build from upstream source (scripts/build-aria2-macos.sh). The previous Homebrew-bottle repack is gone - it only ran where Homebrew's aria2 was already installed.

macos_amd64.notes: Bundled universal build from upstream source (scripts/build-aria2-macos.sh). The previous Homebrew-bottle repack is gone - it only ran where Homebrew's aria2 was already installed.

note: Windows: upstream release archives (aria2/aria2; arm64 from the minnyres community build) downloaded at setup or first use, verified by SHA-256. macOS: aria2 publishes no binary, so the app BUNDLES its own build from the upstream source tarball - vendor/binaries/pxe-macos/aria2c-universal, made by scripts/build-aria2-macos.sh (AppleTLS + SDK libxml2/zlib/sqlite3, no Homebrew). The macOS entries below are informational; Ensure-AppAria2Binary never downloads on macOS.
